steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Ensure vendor addition is not locked, which is the condition under test.
Apply the read-only price-cap setting required by the case configuration.
Apply the required Terms and Conditions configuration.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create test.
Choose the Buy pricing template required for the RFQ.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Open the Terms & Conditions editor to test that the control is clickable.
Assert that the Terms & Conditions editor opens.
